title: ApiEnvironmentWriteResult
description: Result of the api.environment.write JSON-RPC method: the environment file on disk now holds what was sent, and the file is created when nothing occupied the name — a write to a free name is how an environment comes to exist, so there is no second create method. An empty result is still a contract: the file is the truth (design §6.4), so there is nothing for the write to echo back that a read would not answer more honestly.
